composition: Coloured houses along a small harbour basin · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Ærøskøbing harbour is a small basin in front of a cobbled quay, with tiny houses in yellow, pink, and white under red tile roofs and a few wooden boats. The quay is empty. The afternoon is mainly clear, about 16.3°C.5°C. Afternoon sunlight reaches the ground under a thin cloud cover. This is the waterfront, not an inland lane.
